opportunities.name: United flight search by origin, destination, and dates
opportunities.description: Search United.com for flights by typing a departing city or airport and a destination, choosing matching suggestions, setting depart (and optionally return) dates, adjusting passenger count and cabin, then running the search and picking a fare. Parameters: origin, destination, depart date, return date, passenger counts, cabin, and optionally pay with miles.
steps: Open the United flight search form (BOOK tab or flight search).
Type the origin city or airport into the departing field and pick the matching suggestion.
Type the destination city or airport into the destination field and pick the matching suggestion.
Open the date picker, navigate to the target month with the forward or backward arrows, and click the depart date (and return date if roundtrip).
Adjust adult and child counts if needed (add or subtract buttons).
Set the cabin class (Economy, Premium economy) if needed.
Click 'Find flights' or 'Search'.
Select a fare or flight from the results (for example, the roundtrip fare or the price button) and open details or seats if needed.

opportunities.name: TripAdvisor restaurant search by destination with cuisine filter
opportunities.description: From TripAdvisor's Restaurants section, search for a destination, open its restaurant listing, expand the cuisine or feature list, tick one filter, and apply it. Parameters: destination city or place, and the cuisine or feature filter.
steps: Click 'Restaurants' in the top navigation.
Type the destination into the search box and pick the matching suggestion.
On the destination's restaurant page, click 'More restaurants in <destination>' if shown.
Click 'Show more' to expand the cuisine or feature list.
Tick the desired filter checkbox (cuisine or feature).
Click 'Apply'.
parameters: cuisine or feature filter (for example Kosher, Italian, Indian, Outdoor Seating)

opportunities.name: SpotHero event parking search with date, time, and accessibility filters
opportunities.description: Search SpotHero for parking near a sports venue, pick the matching event, apply accessibility filters or a time window, sort results, and update the search. Parameters: venue, event, event date, time window, wheelchair-accessible filter, sort order.
steps: Type the venue name into 'Search for parking' and pick the matching suggestion.
Choose the event date from the date picker if one is offered.
Select the game or event listing matching the desired event.
Open 'Filter' and tick 'Wheelchair Accessible' if needed, then click 'Show N Results'.
Set the start and end time (or start time) from the time dropdowns if needed.
Set the sort order (Sort by Distance or Sort by Price) if needed.
Click 'Update Search' or proceed to 'Book Now' on the chosen listing.
